mapper.select: SELECT conv.other_user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar AS avatar, CASE WHEN msg.message_type = 2 THEN '[图片]' WHEN msg.message_type = 3 THEN '[文件]' ELSE msg.content END AS lastMessage, conv.unread_count AS unreadCount, msg.create_time AS lastMessageTime FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN c.sender_id = #{userId} THEN c.receiver_id ELSE c.sender_id END AS other_user_id, MAX(c.id) AS last_msg_id, SUM(CASE WHEN c.receiver_id = #{userId} AND c.is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread_count FROM user_chat c WHERE c.is_delete = 0 AND (c.sender_id = #{userId} OR c.receiver_id = #{userId}) GROUP BY other_user_id ) conv INNER JOIN user_chat msg ON msg.id = conv.last_msg_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = conv.other_user_id AND u.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY msg.create_time DESC
